{{recipesummary|category=Frosting and icing recipes| Yield = enough for 1 cake|time=½ hour|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Holiday Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==

* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (320 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 11 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
* ⅔ cup (165 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 5.6 oz) [[cookbook:Cream|cream]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]

==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Boil|Boil]] sugar and cream together until a [[Cookbook:Cooking Sugar#Soft Ball|soft ball]] forms in cold water.
# Cool to {{convert|125|F|C}}.
# Add vanilla and butter; [[Cookbook:Beating|beat]] until thick enough to spread.
